## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: 6 drops: NASA Tests 1 to 6 = Bendix drops 10, 11, 12, 13, 16, 17 (Table 5-T2: NASA Drop No. 1 to 6); 4 on RS Loose, 2 on RS Intermediate; Test 4 duplicates Test 1 and Test 3 duplicates Test 2 (text 5-46). Printed differently: Table 5-T2 D_r 0.3 (T5-3 .3) and nominal V_V, V_H; Fig. 5-25 inset V_v = -114.93 in. sec. for Test 1 (T5-3 -114.9); Fig. 5-32 inset V_v = -?0.55, V_h = ?3.75 In. Sec. for Test 2 (T5-3 -60.5, 83.5; first digits broken). Bed gamma and phi differ from Table 2-3 RS Loose (41.4 pcf, 40 deg) and RS Inter. (.45, 45.9 pcf, 44.5 deg). Text 5-44: after each drop the soil was completely removed before a new bed was prepared; no reuse stated. setup_incomplete: footpad diameter and mass not printed in Section V; depth of the loose beds not printed; test gravity not stated (Table 5-T1 scale factors imply 1 g model drops); formula and g used to calculate V_v, V_h from tau not printed
- Codex: Six drops, NASA 1-6, Bendix 10-13 and 16-17. Table 5-T2 gives nominal ft/s and writes 0.3 for .3. Figs. 5-25 and 5-32 give different inset velocities. Loose-bed fill depth and numerical test gravity are unspecified. Fresh bed per drop.
